description: START HERE for SEO recommendations, page optimization, noindex/robots verification, organic traffic or source comparisons. Read SEO evidence for one owned page, with source, scope, units and limitations. Use refresh:true sources:[page] to verify deployed HTML. GSC data is search analytics only; select indexing (page scope) for Google's URL Inspection index status. Saved by default. For a requested diagnosis use freshness:missing to recover absent Google/page evidence without paid Ahrefs reads, or freshness:fresh for explicit live reads. Use scope:site for the exact owned origin; dates, comparePrevious, dimension, limit and offset support search diagnosis. Select backlinks (freshness:fresh, uses Ahrefs allowance) for live referring domains and backlinks to the page, or to the host with scope:site. Select discovery for crawler/content evidence and aiReferrals for GA4 attributed AI sessions (not recommendations). No audits, publication or edits. GSC clicks, GA4 sessions/users and Ahrefs estimates must never be added or relabeled. Empty performance recommendations do not prove technical SEO health. For site-wide sitemap coverage, pages without impressions and duplicate content use get_search_coverage.

auditId.description: Owned saved audit to inspect; omit for latest. Cannot combine with refresh.

discoveryDetail.description: summary returns robots.txt and llms.txt status, size and declared sitemaps; full adds their text.

freshness.description: saved is default. missing refreshes absent selected Google/page/discovery evidence without paid Ahrefs calls. fresh reads selected sources; selecting ahrefs or backlinks authorizes Ahrefs allowance use.

includeSpam.description: backlinks only: keep referring domains and backlinks Ahrefs flags as spam. Excluded by default so genuine links are not crowded out.

pageUrl.description: Exact page on the selected site's origin. Defaults to the site's URL.

refresh.description: False reuses saved evidence without provider calls. True reads selected providers/page; Ahrefs may consume its allowance. Only refresh when requested.

scope.description: Page URL or exact owned site origin

siteId.description: Owned Nimo site ID from list_sites

sources.description: Evidence providers to include; fresh ahrefs or backlinks requires Ahrefs allowance authorization

name: get_seo_evidence

data.description: Source-specific observations; null means unavailable, never zero traffic

title: Read SEO Evidence
